title: The Sevenfold Bestiary
design_rules: Regional ecology and local history determine enemy identity.
Humanoid factions remain politically grounded; monsters are rare and tied to place.
Enemy roles use existing classes, weapons, stats and combat rules; no unimplemented status mechanics are implied.
Atlas-only territories are lore records until their regions become playable.

marsh_hound.name: Marsh Hound
marsh_hound.lore: Lean marsh predators that follow wounded travellers through reed beds.

mire_stalker.name: Mire Stalker
mire_stalker.lore: A long-limbed hunter that waits beneath black water and strikes at the last traveller in a column.

fen_witch.name: Fen Hag
fen_witch.lore: A hedge sorcerer who bargains with the drowned and marks trespassers with ash.

bog_ironbrute.name: Bog Ironbrute
bog_ironbrute.lore: A corpse sealed inside rusted tollhouse plate, animated by the marsh's old boundary oath.

hollowroot_mite.name: Hollowroot Broodling
hollowroot_mite.lore: Pale root-mites nest in the tunnels beneath the Greenward Gate and swarm torchlight.

thornstalker.name: Thornstalker
thornstalker.lore: A lean antlered predator whose bark-coloured hide disappears among the thorn hedges.

briar_wolf.name: Briar Wolf
briar_wolf.lore: Wolves of the old weald carry thorn burrs in their coats and drive prey toward ravines.

antler_guardian.name: Antlered Barrow Guardian
antler_guardian.lore: A barrow sentinel bound to the antler seal; it rises only when the old graves are disturbed.

redwater_raider.name: Redwater Cutthroat
redwater_raider.lore: A toll-road robber who wears stolen Vessmoor colours to frame the local garrisons.

ash_carrion_hawk.name: Ashwing Carrion Hawk
ash_carrion_hawk.lore: A scavenger bird with soot-grey feathers that circles battlefields before the fighting ends.

frostbound.name: Frostbound Reaver
frostbound.lore: A dead border soldier preserved in blue ice, still obeying a commander long buried.

glass_scorpion.name: Glass Dune Scorpion
glass_scorpion.lore: A translucent desert scorpion that hunts beneath salt crust and broken glass.

saltcutthroat_alt.name: Saltmarsh Cutthroat
saltcutthroat_alt.lore: A shore-raider paid to keep the beacon road empty and the harbour frightened.

drowned_sailor.name: Drowned Deckhand
drowned_sailor.lore: A sailor lost beneath the Northstar wreck, returned with weed in his lungs and salt in his eyes.

reef_crawler.name: Reef Crawler
reef_crawler.lore: A many-jointed cave scavenger that clings to wet stone above the tide line.

brine_hexer.name: Brine Hexer
brine_hexer.lore: A tide-cult adept who studies the Seven Flames seal and twists old beacon rites.

tide_gnasher.name: Tide Gnasher
tide_gnasher.lore: A reef-born predator drawn inland by the failing beacon and the smell of blood.

reef_matriarch.name: Reef Matriarch
reef_matriarch.lore: An ancient creature beneath the outer reef; its shell bears the same seven-cut mark as the drowned vault.

veyrwood_canopy_lurker.name: Canopy Lurker
veyrwood_canopy_lurker.lore: A long-armed canopy hunter that drops silently from the old bough roads.

asterreach_stormwing.name: Stormwing Raptor
asterreach_stormwing.lore: A sea-cliff raptor whose cries vanish beneath the thunder rolling off the Stormforged Coast.

ilyr_lantern_wraith.name: Lantern Wraith
ilyr_lantern_wraith.lore: A pale keeper-light that appears on abandoned roads where the covenant lamps were extinguished.

sethmarch.name: Sethmarch — Sallow Marches
sethmarch.title: Sallow Marches Encounter
sethmarch.briefing: The marsh roads conceal hungry beasts, oath-bound dead and desperate outcasts. Read the enemy line before crossing the ford.
sethmarch.ambush_text: Ambush! Marsh hounds break from the reeds as something moves beneath the black water.

brinegate_coast.name: Brinegate Coast
brinegate_coast.title: Brinegate Coast Encounter
brinegate_coast.briefing: The failing beacon has drawn shore-raiders and things from beneath the reef. The tide will not wait for the living.
brinegate_coast.ambush_text: Ambush! Shore-raiders and reef-born things surge from the tide pools.
